name: humanities-wiki
description: Capture humanities sources, organize personal thoughts, answer from prior records, and maintain a persistent LLM wiki.

interface.shortDescription: Humanities source capture and LLM-maintained personal wiki.
interface.longDescription: A Codex plugin for collecting humanities videos, essays, memorable passages, messy personal thoughts, and reflective questions. It follows Andrej Karpathy's LLM wiki pattern: source records and optional user-confirmed full text are kept separately, while the agent incrementally maintains interlinked markdown wiki pages, index.md, and log.md in a separate user-configured Git repository.
defaultPrompt: 이 인문학 에세이 링크를 내 wiki에 정리해줘.
내가 의미 깊게 본 문구들을 기록하고 관련 wiki 페이지를 갱신해줘.
내 생각을 정리하고 이전 기록과 연결해줘.
